questions.question: How is Mordecai described at the end of the book?
options: Forgotten by all very soon after the fall of Haman
Great among the Jews and second in rank to the king
Imprisoned by the king's jealous and scheming officials
Exiled away in deep disgrace to a distant province
questions.answer: Great among the Jews and second in rank to the king
